text:
<start_of_turn>user
Storage almost full. Free up space.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
फोनमे जगह कम भए गेल अछि। पुरान फोटो आ ऐप हटाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Payment failed. Please try again.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
भुगतान नहि भेल। बैलेंस जाँचू आ फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your OTP has expired.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
OTP पुरान भए गेल। Resend OTP करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Login error. Invalid credentials.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Login नहि भेल। Email वा password गलत अछि। फेरसँ जाँचू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
No internet connection.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
इंटरनेट नहि अछि। WiFi वा mobile data चालू करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Update required to continue.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आगू बढ़बाक लेल app update जरूरी अछि। Play Store मे जाकए update करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Session expired. Please log in again.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Session खतम भए गेल। फेरसँ login करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई संदेश की कहैत अछि? — Your subscription has expired.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Subscription खतम भए गेल अछि। नवीकरण करू नहि तँ सेवा बंद भए जाएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई error कियैक आबि रहल अछि? — 404 Not Found
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
जे page खोलए चाहैत छलहुँ से भेटल नहि। link गलत वा page हटा देल गेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
की समस्या भेल अछि? — Account suspended.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
खाता बंद कए देल गेल अछि। Customer Support सँ संपर्क करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एकरा ठीक कएबाक तरीका बताउ — Battery low
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
चार्जरसँ जोड़ू। तुरंत नहि भए सकए तँ brightness कम करू आ background app बंद करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Camera permission denied
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings मे जाकए camera permission दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Download failed
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
इंटरनेट जाँचू आ फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Invalid OTP
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Resend OTP करू आ ध्यानसँ नया code लिखू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Transaction limit exceeded. Try again tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आजुक transaction limit भरि गेल। काल्हि फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई संदेशक मतलब की? — Insufficient balance
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
खातामे पैसा कम अछि। पहिने पैसा जमा करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
New device login detected on your account.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कोनो नया device सँ login भेल। जँ अहाँ नहि केलहुँ तँ तुरंत password बदलू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
की समस्या भेल अछि? — Server error 500
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Server मे समस्या अछि। थोड़े काल बाद फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Weak password. Please choose a stronger one.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password कमजोर अछि। अक्षर, संख्या आ चिन्ह मिलाकए मजबूत password बनाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Microphone access blocked
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings मे जाकए microphone permission चालू करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your free trial has ended. Upgrade to continue.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Free trial खतम भए गेल अछि। सेवा जारी रखबाक लेल upgrade करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एकरा ठीक कएबाक तरीका बताउ — App not responding
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App बंद कए फेर खोलू। नहि भेल तँ phone restart करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
File not found.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Faइल नहि भेटल। शायद हटा देल गेल वा नाम बदलि गेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Location permission required
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings मे जाकए location permission दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your card has been declined.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Card सँ payment नहि भेल। बैंक सँ संपर्क करू वा दोसर card उपयोग करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Email already registered
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Login करू वा दोसर email दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Too many failed attempts. Account locked.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बहुत बेर गलत password देलासँ account lock भए गेल। थोड़े काल बाद वा Forgot Password सँ reset करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई error कियैक आबि रहल अछि? — Connection timed out
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Server जवाब देबामे बहुत देरी केलक। इंटरनेट जाँचू आ फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your subscription will expire in 3 days.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Subscription ३ दिनमे खतम होएत। आबे renew करू नहि तँ access बंद भए जाएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Backup failed
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Storage आ internet जाँचू आ फेर backup करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Refund initiated. Amount will be credited in 3-7 days.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Refund शुरू भए गेल अछि। ३ सँ ७ दिनमे पैसा खातामे आएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
की समस्या भेल अछि? — GPS signal lost
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Location signal नहि भेटि रहल। खुजल जगहमे जाउ आ GPS चालू करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Maximum file size exceeded.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
File बहुत पैघ अछि। छोट file चुनू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Notifications disabled
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Settings मे जाकए notifications चालू करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Verification failed. Please try again.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Sत्यापन नहि भेल। जानकारी फेरसँ जाँचू आ कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एकरा ठीक कएबाक तरीका बताउ — Phone overheating
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Charging बंद करू, background app बंद करू आ ठंडा जगहमे राखू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Password must be at least 8 characters.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Password कमसँ कम ८ अक्षरक हेबाक चाही। आर पैघ password बनाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Coupon expired
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
दोसर coupon खोजू वा बिना coupon भुगतान करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Data sync failed.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Data update नहि भेल। Internet जाँचू आ app फेरसँ खोलू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई संदेश की कहैत अछि? — Your account does not exist.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एहि email वा number सँ कोनो account नहि अछि। पहिने register करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Access denied.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एहि सुविधाक अनुमति नहि अछि। Admin सँ संपर्क करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Fingerprint not recognized
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
उँगरी साफ करू आ फेर कोशिश करू वा password सँ login करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Order cancelled. Refund will be processed.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Order रद्द भए गेल। Refund कुछ दिनमे खातामे आएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
की समस्या भेल अछि? — SIM card not detected
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Phone SIM नहि पहचानि रहल। SIM निकालू, साफ करू आ फेरसँ लगाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Link expired. Request a new one.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Link पुरान भए गेल। नया link लेल फेरसँ request करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Two-factor authentication required
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Phone पर आएल OTP लिखू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your message could not be delivered.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
संदेश नहि पहुँचल। Internet जाँचू आ फेर पठाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एकरा ठीक कएबाक तरीका बताउ — Screen not responding
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Phone restart करू। नहि भेल तँ service center लए जाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Payment successful. Receipt sent to your email.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
भुगतान भए गेल। Receipt email पर पठा देल गेल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — App crash detected
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Phone restart करू आ app फेरसँ खोलू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
This feature is not available in your region.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई सुविधा अहाँक क्षेत्रमे उपलब्ध नहि अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
ई error कियैक आबि रहल अछि? — 403 Forbidden
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एहि page कें देखबाक अनुमति नहि अछि। Login करू वा admin सँ पूछू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Phone number already in use.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई number पहिनहिसँ कोनो account मे अछि। Login करू वा दोसर number दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
1 लाइनमे बताउ — Card expired
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Nया card उपयोग करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Unable to connect to server. Check your connection.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Server सँ संपर्क नहि भए रहल। Internet जाँचू आ थोड़े काल बाद फेर कोशिश करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
छोट उत्तर दियौ — Account already exists
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Login पर जाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
New update available. Install now for better performance.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Nया update आएल अछि। Install करू — app बेसी तेज आ बेहतर होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
एकरा ठीक कएबाक तरीका बताउ — Keyboard not appearing
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
App बंद कए फेर खोलू। नहि भेल तँ phone restart करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Storage full. Cannot take photos.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Storage भरि गेल। Google Photos मे backup करू आ phone सँ पुरान फोटो हटाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
सिर्फ की करबाक चाही बताउ — Mobile number not registered
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
पहिने Register करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Your account has been verified successfully.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
Account सत्यापन भए गेल। आब सब सुविधा उपयोग कए सकैत छी।
<end_of_turn>
